Name: Chest and Minifridges as Japanese-ish Bamboo Baskets
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Retextures chests and mini-fridges to look like baskets, with a visual labelling system as well as multiple colors
Description:
Retextures chests and mini-fridges to look like baskets, with a kind of visual labelling system as well as multiple colors

All items are individually tagged to make searching with Alternative Textures easier!

_Quick start_

1.  Download and extract this mod and it's requirements into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started) ).

2.  It's ready to play

3.  To re-texture items using AT, go to Robin's shop and buy the paint bucket.

4.  For the content patcher version, I recommend using [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to choose your style.
_Compatibility_

*   Should have very little to worry about compatibility wise. You can have multiple AT mods editing chests.

*   For the CP version, if you have multiple mods trying to change how the chest looks then you might have some visual bugs.
Video on how to use AT in-game:
[YouTube](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OzCzEppsXVY)

_Credits_

*   All items with (VT) next to their name are made using sprites from [Vanilla Tweaks](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852) , so this mod has visual compatibility with that one!

Downloads.Description: @AllChestsAT Adds AT textures as options to all chests and the minifridge.

@CP version, only has covered baskets but the lids can change color. Recommended for use with the AT version, but is a good standalone option. Now has a config so you can use it with all, any, or none of the chests.
